description: This source file defines the AWS SDK client class for interacting with the Amazon Kinesis Video Streams Media service. It extends the base AWS client and specifies methods for media retrieval, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: KinesisVideoMediaClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Kinesis Video Streams Media service, with methods for media access.

methods.name: getMedia
methods.description: Retrieves media from Kinesis Video Streams using provided arguments.

methods.name: getMediaAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves media from Kinesis Video Streams.
